_comment: What the developer site (Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles) already has, per entitlements file (each file's identifiers: AppStore.entitlements the app, com.pbordjadze.paintbynumber; Outside.entitlements its .widgets and .stickers), read by ci/capabilities.py. Add an entry in the same change that adds an entitlement, once its developer-site step is done for those identifiers (by Xcode's Apple ID on the Mac or by hand): the API key can't make app groups or turn on SharePlay, so a missing step otherwise shows only on release night.
